title: item_processor
description: Turns a count into that many slugged records. Can fail part way through on purpose, to exercise the platform's failure handling.

fail_at.description: Fail deliberately while processing this item. Null never fails.

label.description: Prefix for each item's title. Defaults to 'Sample Item'.

delay_ms.description: Pause before each item, so a run can be held open long enough to test crash handling.
